## Improvements

- Show provider failures (including authentication errors) in live and restored conversations, even if the response contains no text.
- Synchronize the managed Pi fork with Pi 1.6.0. Preserve pending input, cache maintenance, side questions, and managed child execution.
- Prepare the exact verified private Pi runtime during upgrades even when global Pi is older.
- Refresh installed, unpinned maintained extensions and founder-owned profiles during upgrades. Keep explicit pins, custom packages, resource filters, credentials, and sessions intact. Use `pitty upgrade --no-extensions` to skip extension refresh.
- The maintained DoppelClaude extension also recognizes OAuth revocation errors without an HTTP status and retries them on a fresh subprocess before any output is delivered.

When upgrading from an older PiTTy version, run `pitty founders-setup --refresh-installed` once after restarting to refresh the full installed bundle.
